messages:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — Acme wants a hosted POC. 2 engineers, 2 weeks. Need a short-lived API key with IP allowlist and ability to rotate daily. Can we provision and document rotation/revocation steps for them?
Maria (Solutions Eng): Quick Q: do they need write access (model upload) or just inference?
Alex (Sales): Inference only. They want to test chat + embeddings.
Trent (Infra): Cool. We can create scoped hosted keys restricted to inference routes and set TTL+IP allowlist. Two options: (1) Console-generated scoped key with manual rotation, or (2) ephemeral keys via our admin API with automated TTL.
Maria (Solutions Eng): Prefer (2) if they want daily rotation. I can create a demo script for them. Need example curl and a note about revocation.
Jess (Support): Also note: for enterprise POCs we recommend setting up a single allowlisted egress CIDR on our side OR ask their networking to allow our hosted endpoints. If they require VPC/dedicated later, that’s a separate ticket.
Trent (Infra): Example admin API flow (internal admin token required):
```bash
# create ephemeral scoped key (24h)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-internal.example/admin/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"acme-poc-key-01","scopes":["inference:generate","embeddings:create"],"ttl":"24h","ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.45"]}'
```
Response contains the public key string and expiry.
Maria (Solutions Eng): For rotation the pattern I suggest: create new key (24h), hand it to their engineers, then revoke the previous key after everyone has switched. Revocation call:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-internal.example/admin/keys/acme-poc-key-00/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>"
```
Alex (Sales): Who can execute those admin calls? Can SEs do it or does it need infra?
Trent (Infra): SEs with admin scope in Okta can. Otherwise ops team can run it. We should avoid sending ADMIN_TOKEN over email — use the Console or temporary sessions.
Jess (Support): I'll add a short README to share with Acme: creation steps, example curl, rotation checklist, and revocation link. Also include support contact and recommended TTL (24h for POC).
Maria (Solutions Eng): I'll provision one scoped key now with TTL=24h and IP=203.0.113.45 so they can start. Will post the key privately and set a reminder to rotate every day.
ops-bot: Key created: acme-poc-key-01 (created by Maria). Expires in 24h.
Alex (Sales): Awesome — please DM creds to the two engineers and paste the README to the thread for audit. Marking this as POC-in-progress. :thumbsup:
Jess (Support): Will do. I'll also attach a short troubleshooting checklist (401s, IP mismatch, scope errors).
Maria (Solutions Eng): Done — README posted to the DM and a copy is attached to the customer's POC ticket. We'll loop back if they request Dedicated or Private.
Alex (Sales): Thanks everyone.
